_comment: Manually-maintained DealsX weekly outbound feed. DealsX is external cold-email infra with no API into this dashboard, so Kay (or whoever runs the DealsX sprint review) appends one entry per operational week. The dashboard's 'DealsX · email' channel row reads the entry whose [week_start, week_end] overlaps the rolling 7-day analytics window. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. 'positive' = replies flagged interested/meeting-worthy (subset of 'replied'). 'bounced' = hard+soft bounces (deliverability signal — watch sender reputation).
_schema: weeks[]: {week_start, week_end, sent, replied, positive, bounced}
